senses.zh_definition: 皮博迪：英语专名，可为姓氏，也见于奖项、机构或地名；孤立词形无法确定具体所指。
senses.en_definition: A proper name used as a surname and in the names of awards, institutions, and places.
senses.ms_definition: Nama khas yang digunakan sebagai nama keluarga serta dalam nama anugerah, institusi atau tempat; rujukannya bergantung pada konteks.
senses.nuances: 通常写作 Peabody，不是可直接赋予普通马来语词义的词形。资料包未提供正式马来语收录证据；马来语释义为编辑释义，排名仅沿用资料包。没有可靠的马来语派生词，因此 word_family 留空。下列为专名组合示例，不能据此认定原始语料指向奖项。参考读音见 [Cambridge: Peabody pronunciation](https://dictionary.cambridge.org/us/pronunciation/english/peabody)；奖项名称见 [Peabody Awards: Our Story](https://peabodyawards.com/our-story/)。

dual_scenarios.context: 新闻 / 广播媒体文化介绍
dual_scenarios.ms: Anugerah Peabody dinamakan sempena George Foster Peabody bagi menghargai sumbangannya kepada Universiti Georgia.
dual_scenarios.zh: 皮博迪奖以乔治·福斯特·皮博迪命名，以表彰他对佐治亚大学的贡献。
dual_scenarios.en: The Peabody Awards were named after George Foster Peabody in recognition of his contributions to the University of Georgia.

etymology.historical_story: One cultural association of Peabody comes from the broadcasting awards named after George Foster Peabody. The first awards were presented in 1941 for radio programmes broadcast in 1940. The name honoured his contributions to the University of Georgia; the awards were not created through a provision in his will. This explains the award name, not the surname's ultimate etymology. [Source: Peabody Awards](https://peabodyawards.com/our-story/).
